Rationale.CS1_Results_vs_Conclusion: The plan.md claims that 'linear probes never dip below 20% error across all layers' (based on the original Li et al. paper). However, the implementation notebook (Othello_GPT_Circuits.ipynb, Cell 66) demonstrates that linear probes achieve ~0.4% average error rate when using a 'my color vs their color' framing. This is a direct contradiction between the documented claims and the recorded experimental results. The plan's Hypothesis 3 states 'nonlinear probes are necessary' while the notebook concludes 'the network actually learns a linear world model'.
Rationale.CS2_Plan_vs_Implementation: All 5 methodology steps from the plan are implemented: (1) 8-layer GPT model with 8-head attention and 512-dim hidden space is configured in mingpt/model.py and train_gpt_othello.ipynb; (2) Two datasets (championship and synthetic) are supported in data/othello.py; (3) Nonlinear probes (2-layer MLPs) are implemented in mingpt/probe_model.py and trained via train_probe_othello.py; (4) Interventional experiments are implemented in intervening_probe_interact_column.ipynb; (5) Latent saliency maps are created via plot_attribution_via_intervention_othello.ipynb with outputs in the togglable/ directory.
